change_rules: Newly found upstream capabilities enter only as new IDs, with evidence and user approval.

No ID is deleted. A capability confirmed absent upstream keeps its ID, is marked upstream_unconfirmed (or project_enhancement when the project keeps an implementation) and is not counted in the parity completion rate.
Wording changes need evidence and a recorded reason.
Every change updates all three ledgers and reruns the structure validation.

parity_counting_meaning.absent: Counted in the parity completion rate.
